## What was done (branch `agent/brand-theme`, base `4104d2bb`, uncommitted as instructed)

**Files changed (6, +43/−17):** `src/ui/assets.rs`, `src/ui/theme.rs`, `src/shell/help.rs`, `src/shell/tests/end_to_end/settings.rs`, `src/main.rs`, `docs/index.html`. No launcher files, no `Cargo.toml`, no commits.

**Per-surface mapping:**
- **Rail mark** (`src/ui/assets.rs` `logo()`, sole-new-code; caller `src/shell/sidebar.rs:1190` untouched): replaced the two-cards path data with the kit's optical 16 px simplified mark (`svg/inkuno-mark-16.svg`), coordinates ×1/32 into the 16 px grid — nib `M5.1875 2.6875H10.8125L12.21875 6.59375L8 12.65625L3.78125 6.59375Z`, stroke `M5.4375 13.9375Q7.96875 12.8125 10.5625 13.6875` w1.1875. Key finding: **gpui renders SVG as a monochrome alpha mask** (`svg_renderer.rs`: alpha pixels + single tint), so exact kit colors need two layers — new `logo-ink.svg` arm (cobalt stroke) overlaid on `logo.svg` (charcoal nib) via `relative` container + `absolute inset_0` layers. **VISIBLE CHANGE (as required to report): the `t.accent.opacity(0.85)` tint is gone** — the mark is now always `#20232B` + `#4263EB`, no longer following the theme accent. Same mark automatically flows to the empty-state today's row (`render.rs:796`, third caller the scout map missed — no edit needed, it uses `.child(logo(t))`).
- **About footer lockup** (`src/shell/help.rs:617`): mark + lowercase wordmark — `inkuno {version}` (was `Inkuno …`). **Deliberate deviation, no new `wordmark.svg` arm:** (1) `load()` hardcodes a 16×16 viewBox, so a wide 1120×260 lockup arm would need a special-case wrapper; (2) monochrome rendering would reduce the whole lockup (incl. cobalt stroke) to one tint; (3) usvg `<text>` resolves via system fonts, not bundled Inter — a real text node next to the exact-color mark is crisper and localizable. Integrator: say the word if you want the arm anyway.
- **Theme re-seed** (`src/ui/theme.rs:139-151`): Dark `bg 0x1b1a19→0x171a22`, `text 0xe4e0da→0xf5f5f2`, `accent 0xe0926b→0x4263eb`; Light `bg 0xfbfaf8→0xf5f5f2`, `text 0x26231f→0x20232b`, `accent 0x5f48b0→0x4263eb`. Panel/code/dim/border untouched; `of()` WCAG auto-fixups absorb the new cobalt (dark accent ~3.5:1 raw → lightened by `legible()`; light ~4.6:1 stays).
- **Docs** (`docs/index.html:15,21`): both `:root` accents → `#4263eb` (bg/text left as-is per scope).
- **Consistency updates:** `--help` `themes.json` example (`src/main.rs:50-52`) → new Dark seeds; e2e `settings.rs:195` Light-bg expectation `0xfbfaf8→0xf5f5f2`.

**Verification (fast-lane, no builds per 20-min gate):** rustfmt parses all 6 files clean — the only `--check` diffs are pre-existing import-ordering noise identical on HEAD (local rustfmt 1.9 vs repo style; my lines match repo style). Grep review: zero stale `0x…` seed refs outside test-example data; all 3 `logo(t)` callers are type-agnostic `.child()`; no other `gpui::Svg`-typed dependency. Geometry sanity: nib x 3.78–12.22 / y 2.69–12.66, stroke bottom ≈14.3 < 16, no clipping. **Not verified:** no `cargo build/test` run (gate); integrator should run at least `cargo test theme` + the settings e2e.

- `src/shell/sidebar.rs:1188-1195` and `src/shell/render.rs:796` — **not edited** (only `logo()`'s return type changed `gpui::Svg → impl IntoElement`); trim-crew tree-header work there should rebase cleanly.
- `src/ui/theme.rs:139-151` (THEMES seeds) — edited; conflicts only if a trim crew touched the same hunk.
- `src/shell/help.rs:617`, `src/shell/tests/end_to_end/settings.rs:195`, `src/main.rs:50-52`, `src/ui/assets.rs:412-631` — edited, flag if trim crews touched these lines.

**Open questions + evidence for the two parked decisions:**
1. Dark-theme nib visibility: charcoal `#20232B` on `#171A22` ≈ **1.1:1** — the nib is near-invisible on Inkuno Dark; only the cobalt stroke (≈3.5:1) carries the mark. Kit rule says keep as-is, so I shipped it, but the integrator may want the monochrome-variant fallback on dark.
2. Root `inkuno.ico` orphan: **evidence — zero references** to `inkuno.ico` in `*.rs`/`*.toml`/`*.md`/`Makefile`/`*.json`/`*.yml`. Looks safe to delete, but that's slice 1's lane — I left it.
3. Linux light-vs-default: **evidence — no action needed**: `Theme::of` (`theme.rs:403-414`) already falls back to the system-appearance-matching built-in (`THEMES[0]` dark / `THEMES[1]` light), never a hardcoded Light.
